ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:1.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:1.original: Oh, you've come at just the right time. I was just about to head to your atelier.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:1.translation: О, ты пришла как раз вовремя. Я как раз собиралась зайти к вам в ателье.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:2.original: Huh...? Our atelier?! You weren't going to give us our next task, were you?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:2.translation: А...? В наше ателье?! Ты же не собиралась дать нам следующее задание?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:3.original: Augh! How terrible, Lydie! We've been caught completely unprepared! Arrghh!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:3.translation: Ааа! Какой ужас, Лиди! Нас застали совершенно неготовыми! Ааа!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:4.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:4.original: Wait a minute! Just calm down! Stop acting like I'm some monster who's always testing you!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:4.translation: Погодите минуту! Успокойтесь! Перестаньте вести себя так, будто я какой-то монстр, который только и проверяет вас!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:5.original: Huh... But that's more or less true...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:7.original: U-Uh, nothing, nothing... But Ilmeria, if you didn't want to give us a new task, then why...?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:7.translation: Н-ничего, ничего... Но, Ильмерия, если ты не хотела давать нам новое задание, то почему...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:8.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:8.original: Hmph, well, listen and be amazed. I wanted to come and offer to help you gather new materials!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:8.translation: Хмф, ну слушайте и удивляйтесь. Я хотела прийти и предложить помочь вам собрать новые материалы!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:9.original: Help us...? You mean, you're going to come with us?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:9.translation: Помочь нам...? То есть ты пойдёшь с нами?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:10.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:10.original: Precisely. Things have calmed down a little, so I thought I'd teach you the fundamentals of gathering up close.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:10.translation: Именно. Ситуация немного успокоилась, поэтому я решила научить вас основам сбора материалов вблизи.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:11.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:11.original: Hehehe, be well aware that this won't be easy. Make a mistake, and you'll pay for it...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:11.translation: Хе-хе-хе, имейте в виду: это будет непросто. Ошибитесь — и поплатитесь...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:15.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:15.original: Sue! Sue! We finally get to go on an adventure with our teacher!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:15.translation: Сью! Сью! Наконец-то мы отправимся в приключение с нашим учителем!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:16.original: I know, Lydie! Isn't it wonderful?! You always said you wanted to travel with Ilmeria!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:16.translation: Знаю, Лиди! Разве это не чудесно?! Ты всегда говорила, что хочешь путешествовать с Ильмерией!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:17.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:17.original: That's right! It's always been my dream... to go places with her, and gather materials with her...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:17.translation: Верно! Я всегда мечтала... ходить с ней куда угодно и собирать с ней материалы...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:22.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:22.original: ...Hehe, then leave it to me! After all, I am your teacher.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:22.translation: ...Хе-хе, тогда положитесь на меня! Всё-таки я ваш учитель.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:23.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:23.original: Just sit back and trust that you're in good hands... Lydie, Sue, let's make the most of this!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:23.translation: Просто расслабьтесь и верьте, что вы в надёжных руках... Лиди, Сью, давайте извлечём из этого максимум!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:1.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:1.original: Wh-What's the matter? Why did you start sulking as soon as you saw me...?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:1.translation: Ч-что случилось? Почему ты начала дуться, как только увидела меня...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:2.original: Hahaha, well, here's the thing... You're really strong, right, Ilmeria?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:2.translation: Ха-ха-ха, ну вот в чём дело... Ты ведь очень сильная, да, Ильмерия?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:3.original: Well, yes, I suppose. I can certainly handle most monsters you'll come across round these parts.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:3.translation: Ну да, полагаю. Я, конечно, справлюсь с большинством монстров, которых вы встретите в этих краях.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:4.original: That's the problem. That's why Sue's a little upset...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:4.translation: В том-то и проблема. Поэтому Сью немного расстроена...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:6.original: ...If you're so strong, then why didn't you help us until now?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:6.translation: ...Если ты такая сильная, то почему не помогала нам до сих пор?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:7.original: If you had helped us, our investigations of the paintings would have been so much easier! Hmph!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:7.translation: Если бы вы нам помогли, наши исследования картин были бы куда проще! Хмф!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:8.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:8.original: Oh, I see. You don't seem to understand my intent. There was an important reason for me not to help you!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:8.translation: Ага, понятно. Кажется, вы не понимаете моих намерений. У меня была важная причина не помогать вам!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:10.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:10.original: Precisely! If you have your teacher by your side all the time, and rely on them, it would hamper your development.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:10.translation: Именно! Если учитель всё время рядом и вы всё время на него полагаетесь, это мешает вашему развитию.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:11.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:11.original: That's why I decided not to go with you. Even though it tore me up inside. Can't you appreciate the sacrifice I made?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:11.translation: Вот почему я решила не идти с вами. Хоть это и разрывало меня изнутри. Разве вы не можете оценить ту жертву, которую я принесла?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:12.original: Teacher... That's all nice, but you should tell us the truth...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:12.translation: Учитель... Это всё хорошо, но скажите нам правду...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:14.original: I knew it! You see - you put your work before your students! That's why I'm so upset! Hmph!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:14.translation: Я так и знала! Видите — вы ставите работу выше учеников! Вот почему я так расстроена! Хмф!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:15.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:15.original: D-Don't be so demanding! I'm helping you now, aren't I?! Be satisfied with that!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:15.translation: Н-не будьте такими требовательными! Я же помогаю вам сейчас, правда?! Будьте этим довольны!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:16.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:16.original: I mean... I also wish I could have spent more time with you...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:16.translation: То есть... мне тоже хотелось бы проводить с вами больше времени...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:17.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:17.original: ...Hehe. Come on, Sue. Let's cut our teacher some slack, okay?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:17.translation: ...Хе-хе. Давай, Сью. Давай немного пощадим нашего учителя, ладно?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:18.original: You know full well how busy she's been. Right, Sue?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:18.translation: Ты прекрасно знаешь, насколько она была занята. Верно, Сью?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:19.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:19.original: ...I wasn't really that angry to begin with. But you have to make us a promise, as our teacher!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:19.translation: ...Поначалу я и не была так уж зла. Но вы должны дать нам обещание как наш учитель!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:20.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:20.original: From now on, we come first, not your other work! Okay?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:20.translation: Отныне на первом месте мы, а не ваша другая работа! Хорошо?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:21.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:21.original: Haha, you really are demanding... All right, I understand.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:21.translation: Ха-ха, вы и правда требовательные... Ладно, я понимаю.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:22.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:22.original: I promise I'll go with you wherever you want to go. Is that what you want?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:22.translation: Обещаю: я пойду с вами, куда бы вы ни пожелали. Этого вы хотите?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:24.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:24.original: ...Oh, and one more thing. You have to bring some sweets! And something to drink would be nice, too...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:24.translation: ...О, и ещё кое-что. Надо принести сладостей! Да и попить было бы неплохо...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:25.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:25.original: Hey! I'm not your servant, you know! I'm not doing that!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:25.translation: Эй! Я вам не служанка, знаете ли! Я этого делать не буду!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:26.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:26.original: Hmph, I knew you were cheap! Can't you even do that much for us?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:26.translation: Хмф, я так и знала, что вы жадина! Неужели даже этого для нас не можете?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:27.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:27.original: No! I'm the teacher, you're my students! If anyone should be bringing treats along, it should be you...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:27.translation: Нет! Я учитель, вы мои ученики! Если кто и должен приносить угощения, так это вы...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:1.original: Oh, Ilmeria? What are you doing here in the gallery?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:1.translation: О, Ильмерия? Что вы делаете здесь, в галерее?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:2.original: Ah, there you both are. I've been conducting a little research of my own into the Mysterious Paintings.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:2.translation: Ах, вот вы обе. Я провожу небольшое собственное исследование Таинственных картин.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:3.original: I've ended up leaving all the work to you so far... But, as an alchemist, I am fascinated by them as well.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:3.translation: До сих пор я оставляла всю работу вам... Но как алхимик я тоже ими очарована.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:4.original: Oh, that's our teacher! Always passionate about learning!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:4.translation: О, вот наш учитель! Всегда горит желанием учиться!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:5.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:5.original: Well, of course. But the thing is, I have a little bit of a problem...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:5.translation: Ну конечно. Но дело в том, что у меня небольшая проблема...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:7.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:7.original: It's the Paintings. They're all kept here, right? It's tiresome to have to come all the way to the castle to see them...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:7.translation: Картины. Они все хранятся здесь, верно? Утомительно ехать до самого замка, чтобы их увидеть...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:8.original: I see... I suppose you do have a point...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:9.original: It would be easier to investigate them if they were closer to hand...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:9.translation: Было бы легче исследовать их, если бы они были поближе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:10.original: Hehehe, dear teacher. Leave everything to me.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:10.translation: Хе-хе-хе, дорогой учитель. Оставьте всё мне.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:11.original: I may not be able to move the Mysterious Paintings, but I do have a "Slightly Mysterious Painting" on me!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:11.translation: Я, может, и не смогу переместить Таинственные картины, но у меня с собой есть «Слегка Таинственная картина»!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:12.original: A "Slightly Mysterious Painting"?! S-Sue, how did you...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:13.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:13.original: Well, I don't care. As long as it's mysterious! Sue, will you show me your Painting?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:13.translation: Ну, мне всё равно. Лишь бы была таинственной! Сью, покажешь мне свою картину?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:14.original: Of course! Tadaa! Here it is!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:16.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:16.original: I see... This is your "Slightly Mysterious Painting"... It's a fascinating work indeed... Very peculiar style...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:16.translation: Понятно... Это ваша «Слегка Таинственная картина»... Действительно увлекательная работа... Очень своеобразный стиль...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:17.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:17.original: If I restore it, I should be able to enter the painting world too... I must return and begin at once! Thank you!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:17.translation: Если я её восстановлю, то тоже смогу войти в мир картины... Нужно скорее вернуться и начать! Спасибо!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:18.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:18.original: Ah, she's gone... I only meant it as a joke...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:18.translation: Ах, она ушла... Я только пошутила...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:19.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:19.original: You fool! You stupid, stupid girl! You know full well that I painted that!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:19.translation: Ты дура! Глупая, глупая девчонка! Ты прекрасно знаешь, что это я её нарисовала!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:20.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:20.original: Sorry, sorry. But think about it this way. Our teacher thought your painting was good.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:20.translation: Прости, прости. Но подумай вот так: наш учитель посчитала, что ты хорошо рисуешь.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:21.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:21.original: Only as a "Slightly Mysterious Painting"! Hmph, of course she'd think my paintings are "mysterious"...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:21.translation: Только как «Слегка Таинственную картину»! Хмф, конечно, она подумает, что мои картины «таинственные»...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:22.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:22.original: What else would you call a painting that can do what this does...? How can you not see that? Haha...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:22.translation: А как ещё назвать картину, которая умеет то, что умеет эта...? Как ты можешь этого не видеть? Ха-ха...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:0.original: I really am happy to be able to fight alongside you again, Ilmeria. I really feel like I can trust you to cover my back!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:0.translation: Я и правда рада снова сражаться вместе с тобой, Ильмерия. Чувствую, что могу доверить тебе прикрывать мне спину!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:1.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:1.original: Well, I won't deny that I like it too. Besides, unless I'm near you, I feel like I'll get caught up in one of your explosions.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:1.translation: Ну, не буду отрицать — мне тоже это нравится. К тому же, если я не рядом, кажется, я обязательно попаду под один из твоих взрывов.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:2.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:2.original: Come on, I wouldn't do that... Probably. I don't think I've ever done that before, have I...?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:2.translation: Да ладно, я бы так не сделала... Наверное. Не думаю, что когда-либо так делала... правда?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:3.original: Excuse us! Oh, it's Firis. Have you come here to get some sweets from our teacher?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:3.translation: Простите! О, это Фирис. Вы пришли сюда за сладостями от нашего учителя?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:4.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:4.original: Oh, you saw right through me. I just decided to have some tea with Ilmeria!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:4.translation: О, ты меня насквозь видишь. Я просто решила попить чаю с Ильмерией!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:5.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:5.original: ...Oh, seeing you reminds me, Sue. There was something I meant to ask Ilmeria about.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:5.translation: ...О, глядя на вас, я вспомнила, Сью. Я хотела кое о чём спросить Ильмерию.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:6.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:6.original: Something you wanted to ask me? I hope it isn't anything too weird...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:6.translation: Ты что-то хотела у меня спросить? Надеюсь, ничего слишком странного...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:7.original: Don't worry... Ilmeria, I've noticed you haven't used your gun much recently. It looked so cool on you. How come?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:7.translation: Не волнуйся... Ильмерия, я заметила, что в последнее время ты мало пользуешься пистолетом. На тебе это выглядело так круто. Почему?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:8.original: A-A gun...?! You used to use a gun?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:9.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:9.original: Of course. My father taught me how to use it when I was young.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:9.translation: Конечно. Отец научил меня пользоваться им, когда я была маленькой.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:10.original: Huh...! Our teacher with a gun...! I'd love to see that...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:10.translation: Ох...! Наш учитель с пистолетом...! Я бы очень хотела это увидеть...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:11.original: But Firis is right - we've never seen you use one. Is there a reason for that?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:11.translation: Но Фирис права: мы никогда не видели, чтобы вы им пользовались. Есть ли для этого причина?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:14.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:14.original: ...Mireille. As you know, I have been officially invited by this country to set up an atelier here.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:14.translation: ...Мирей. Как вы знаете, эта страна официально пригласила меня открыть здесь ателье.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:15.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:15.original: As I play a public role, I have been forbidden from using anything other than a traditional alchemist's staff.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:15.translation: Поскольку я исполняю общественную роль, мне запрещено пользоваться чем-либо, кроме традиционного посоха алхимика.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:16.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:16.original: Oh, I see... I had no idea you operated under such strict rules...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:16.translation: О, понятно... Я и не знала, что вы действуете по таким строгим правилам...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:17.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:17.original: Nor did I. If we were under the country's auspices, both Sue and I would be forced to change too.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:17.translation: И я тоже. Если бы мы были под эгидой страны, и Сью, и мне тоже пришлось бы измениться.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:18.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:18.original: Hehe... Yes, dealing with the bureaucracy of a state is actually a lot more troublesome than it appears.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:18.translation: Хе-хе... Да, иметь дело с государственной бюрократией на самом деле куда хлопотнее, чем кажется.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:19.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:19.original: Don't you forget that, Lydie, Sue. You either, Firis. Hehehe...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:19.translation: Не забывайте об этом, Лиди, Сью. И ты тоже, Фирис. Хе-хе-хе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:20.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:20.original: I-I see... The politics of the real world can be very tricky...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:20.translation: П-понятно... Политика реального мира может быть очень сложной...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:0.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:0.original: Hmm, I see... I wonder if that's due to a difference between schools of alchemic thought...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:0.translation: Хм, понятно... Интересно, связано ли это с разницей между школами алхимической мысли...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:1.original: Yes, probably. Plachta's alchemy may actually differ slightly from modern-day alchemy...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:1.translation: Да, наверное. Алхимия Плахты может немного отличаться от современной...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:2.original: Hello... Oh, Firis. What are you and Ilmeria talking about?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:2.translation: Здравствуйте... О, Фирис. О чём вы с Ильмерией говорите?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:3.original: Oh, there you are. In fact, we were just talking about that thing you two came up with.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:3.translation: О, вот и вы. Как раз говорили о том, что вы двое придумали.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:4.original: That thing...? What do you mean? The "Fully-Automatic Lecture Machine Ilmeria Mark 3", maybe?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:4.translation: О том...? Что вы имеете в виду? Может, «Полностью автоматическая лекционная машина Ильмерия Mark 3»?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:5.original: No, I bet they're talking about the "Pretty Ilmeria Doll"... Ah!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:5.translation: Нет, уверена — они говорят о «Красивой кукле Ильмерии»... Ах!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:6.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:6.original: Hehe...! Lecture Machine...! Pretty Ilmeria Doll..?! Hehehe...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:6.translation: Хе-хе...! Лекционная машина...! Милая кукла Ильмерия..?! Хе-хе-хе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:7.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:7.original: Wh-What are you two talking about? Why are you wasting your time thinking up things like that?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:7.translation: Ч-о чём вы двое говорите? Зачем тратите время на такие глупости?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:8.original: U-Uh-oh...! Umm, Firis, what was it you were talking about?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:8.translation: Ой-ой...! Эм, Фирис, о чём вы говорили?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:9.original: Y-Yes! Tell us, please! We really would like to know!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:9.translation: Д-да! Расскажите нам, пожалуйста! Нам очень хочется знать!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:10.original: Huh? Oh, it was "Battle Mix." You know, the technique you use to synthesize things in-battle.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:10.translation: А? О, это был «Боевой синтез». Ну, техника, которой вы синтезируете прямо в бою.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:11.original: Ah! That was a revolutionary idea, even if I do say so myself. A truly historic achievement, if you'd like.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:11.translation: Ах! Это была революционная идея, даже если я так сама говорю. Поистине историческое достижение, если угодно.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:12.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:12.original: ...You might be right. I mean, it's turned the conventional alchemic wisdom on its head.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:12.translation: ...Возможно, ты права. Это перевернуло общепринятую алхимическую мудрость с ног на голову.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:14.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:14.original: It's that you don't use anything like a cauldron. Traditionally, alchemy has always been conducted in a vessel...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:14.translation: Дело в том, что вы не используете ничего вроде котла. Традиционно алхимия всегда велась в сосуде...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:15.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:15.original: But "Battle Mix" makes use of Anima, allowing you to synthesize without any vessel.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:15.translation: Но в «Боевом синтезе» используется Анима, позволяющая синтезировать без всякого сосуда.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:16.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:16.original: That's a remarkable achievement. But it does make it more difficult.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:16.translation: Это замечательное достижение. Но из-за этого всё сложнее.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:17.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:17.original: Sophie and I tried it out several times, but we just couldn't get it to work...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:17.translation: Мы с Софи пробовали несколько раз, но так и не смогли заставить это работать...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:18.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:18.original: What?! Sophie and Firis...?! This is too much! Too much, Lydie! This is amazing!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:18.translation: Что?! Софи и Фирис...?! Это слишком! Слишком, Лиди! Это потрясающе!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:19.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:19.original: I-I know! This makes it all somehow feel more real...! We invented something really incredible!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:19.translation: Я-я знаю! От этого всё как-то становится реальнее...! Мы изобрели нечто поистине невероятное!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:20.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:20.original: Haha... Well, Firis and I think the difficulty may be due to differences in schools of alchemy.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:20.translation: Ха-ха... Ну, мы с Фирис думаем, что трудности могут быть связаны с различиями школ алхимии.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:21.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:21.original: But it is certainly true that you two are very talented alchemists, to come up with something so remarkable.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:21.translation: Но правда в том, что вы двое очень талантливые алхимики, раз придумали нечто столь замечательное.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:22.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:22.original: You should stop wasting your time with lecture machines and dolls, and make something else truly useful.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:22.translation: Вам бы стоило перестать тратить время на лекционные машины и куклы и заняться чем-то по-настоящему полезным.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:23.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:23.original: Okay! Something truly useful... I'll remember that!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:23.translation: Хорошо! Что-то по-настоящему полезное... Я это запомню!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:24.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:24.original: Then I will invent the "Medicine Distributor Angel Ilmeria" to hand out medicine to patients!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:24.translation: Тогда я изобрету «Ангела-раздатчицу лекарств Ильмерию», чтобы раздавать лекарства пациентам!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:25.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:25.original: And I will make a machine that automatically plows fields - the "Il-dozer"!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:25.translation: А я сделаю машину, которая сама вспахивает поля — «Ил-дозер»!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:26.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:26.original: Hey! Stop coming up with things relating to me! I'm going to get really mad...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:26.translation: Эй! Хватит придумывать вещи, связанные со мной! Я правда разозлюсь...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:29.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:29.original: Haha! At least you get along so well. I've never seen such camaraderie between a teacher and their students.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:29.translation: Ха-ха! По крайней мере, вы так хорошо ладите. Я никогда не видела такого товарищества между учителем и учениками.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:0.original: Hello there, Lydie and Sue! Listen, you two... What would you say about going on a trip?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:0.translation: Привет, Лиди и Сью! Слушайте, вы двое... Что скажете насчёт путешествия?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:1.original: A trip...? Of course we'd love to... But this is all very sudden.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:1.translation: Путешествия...? Конечно, нам бы очень хотелось... Но это всё очень внезапно.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:2.original: I'm sorry... We have lots of work to do, so we can't go far...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:2.translation: Простите... У нас много работы, поэтому далеко уйти не получится...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:3.original: Hehee, don't you worry! In fact, I've made a special tool just for this!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:3.translation: Хе-хи, не волнуйтесь! На самом деле я сделала специальный инструмент именно для этого!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:4.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:4.original: Never has there been a handier tool - use this, and you can go anywhere in a single leap: the "Travel Gate"!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:4.translation: Удобнее инструмента ещё не было — с ним можно попасть куда угодно одним прыжком: «Тревел-гейт»!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:5.original: Anywhere in a single leap?! You've come up with something incredible once again...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:5.translation: Куда угодно одним прыжком?! Вы снова придумали что-то невероятное...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:6.original: Hmm... I feel like common sense has taken a leap somewhere as well...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:6.translation: Хм... Кажется, здравый смысл тоже куда-то скакнул...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:7.original: Common sense loses all meaning in the face of my insatiable desire to travel!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:7.translation: Здравый смысл теряет всякий смысл перед моим ненасытным желанием путешествовать!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:9.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:9.original: Anyway. I plan to use this tool to return to some of the places of which I have fond memories.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:9.translation: Так или иначе. Я планирую с помощью этого инструмента вернуться в места, о которых у меня остались тёплые воспоминания.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:10.original: Hehe, if you want, you can come with me! In fact, you're coming, even if you don't want to! Aren't you?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:10.translation: Хе-хе, если хотите — можете пойти со мной! Нет, вы пойдёте, даже если не хотите! Правда?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:11.original: Haha...! Of course! We'd love to see some of your favorite places...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:11.translation: Ха-ха...! Конечно! Нам бы очень хотелось увидеть ваши любимые места...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:12.original: All right then, Firis! We'll go with you!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:12.translation: Тогда ладно, Фирис! Мы пойдём с тобой!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:13.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:13.original: I knew you'd say that! Once you're ready, let's go!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:13.translation: Я знала, что вы так скажете! Как будете готовы — поехали!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:14.speaker: System
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:14.original: You can now go to <CLEG>Claudel Prairie<CLNR>!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_060.ebm:14.translation: Теперь вы можете отправиться на <CLEG>Клодельскую равнину<CLNR>!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:2.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:2.original: Hehe, what do you think? It's pretty huge, right? It's beautiful, right?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:2.translation: Хе-хе, ну как? Довольно огромная, правда? Красивая, да?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:3.translation: Да, это потрясающе...! У меня нет слов...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:4.original: Haha, I feel like I could run forever! What an incredible place! Hahaha!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:4.translation: Ха-ха, кажется, я могла бы бежать вечно! Какое невероятное место! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:5.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:5.original: I traveled here to Claudel Prairie when I took my certification examination.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:5.translation: Я приехала сюда, на Клодельскую равнину, когда сдавала сертификационный экзамен.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:6.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:6.original: But before I got here, I was actually delayed for quite a while.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:6.translation: Но прежде чем добраться сюда, я надолго застряла в пути.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:7.original: The date had already been set for my certification examination, so I was really quite panicky...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:7.translation: Дата экзамена уже была назначена, так что я сильно паниковала...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:8.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:8.original: But with the help of my friends, somehow we managed to solve the problems that faced us!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:8.translation: Но с помощью друзей нам как-то удалось решить стоявшие перед нами проблемы!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:9.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:9.original: Hehe, I was so happy when I finally made it here...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:9.translation: Хе-хе, я была так счастлива, когда наконец добралась сюда...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:11.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:11.original: And that's why this place will always be special to me.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:11.translation: И поэтому это место всегда будет для меня особенным.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:12.original: It was where I learned that if you work together with your friends, you can overcome any hardships.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:12.translation: Именно здесь я узнала: если работать вместе с друзьями, можно преодолеть любые трудности.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:13.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:13.original: Hehe... In a way, then, this place made you who you are, Firis.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:13.translation: Хе-хе... В каком-то смысле это место сделало тебя той, кто ты есть, Фирис.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:15.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:15.original: What are you two talking about?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:16.original: I saw so many interesting things on just one little run... I can't wait any longer!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:16.translation: Я увидела столько интересного всего за одну небольшую пробежку... Больше не могу ждать!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:17.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:17.original: Come on, let's go explore! Come on, come on!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:18.original: Okay, okay. In that case, Firis...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:19.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:19.original: Okay! Lydie, Sue! It's time to head off on a mysterious journey!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:19.translation: Хорошо! Лиди, Сью! Пора отправиться в таинственное путешествие!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:22.speaker: System
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:22.original: By checking the signboard in Claudel Prairie you will be able to select where you wish to go from 6 available locations.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:22.translation: Проверив вывеску на Клодельской равнине, вы сможете выбрать, куда отправиться, из 6 доступных мест.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:23.speaker: System
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:23.original: There is a new request in Claudel Prairie! You can access it at the Notice Board.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_070.ebm:23.translation: На Клодельской равнине появился новый заказ! Его можно принять на доске объявлений.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:0.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:0.original: ...This place brings back so many memories.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:1.original: Yes... This was where you and I first started our travels together.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:1.translation: Да... Именно здесь мы с тобой впервые начали путешествовать вместе.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:2.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:2.original: Of course, I wanted to go off on adventures with you earlier than that...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:2.translation: Конечно, мне хотелось отправиться с тобой в приключения ещё раньше...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:3.original: H-Hey, I couldn't help that! I was under serious pressure of my own, you know!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:3.translation: Э-эй, я ничего не могла с этим поделать! Знаешь ли, у меня самой было серьёзное давление!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:4.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:4.original: I had to pass the certification examination to get my father to accept me as an alchemist...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:4.translation: Мне нужно было сдать сертификационный экзамен, чтобы отец признал меня алхимиком...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:5.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:5.original: It was a really tough time for me. I just thought I should do things on my own.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:5.translation: Для меня это было очень тяжёлое время. Я просто решила, что должна справляться сама.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:6.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:6.original: That's why... That's why it took so long for me to trust you... It was all my own fault, but still...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:6.translation: Вот почему... Вот почему мне так долго требовалось тебе довериться... Это была моя вина, но всё же...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:7.original: ...Haha, don't worry about it. You and I were both desperate to change our lives.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:7.translation: ...Ха-ха, не волнуйся. Мы обе отчаянно хотели изменить свою жизнь.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:8.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:8.original: You can't see the future. No one knows what tomorrow will bring.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:8.translation: Будущее не видно. Никто не знает, что принесёт завтрашний день.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:9.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:9.original: That's why we have to give our absolute best, to ensure a brighter future. The possibilities are endless!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:9.translation: Поэтому мы должны выкладываться на полную, чтобы обеспечить светлое будущее. Возможности безграничны!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:10.original: The fact that I am here now with everyone on this journey, it's all thanks to the efforts you and I made back then.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:10.translation: То, что я сейчас здесь со всеми в этом путешествии, — всё благодаря усилиям, которые мы тогда приложили.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:11.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:11.original: Hehe, I guess you're right. Our past makes our present, and that leads on to the future.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:11.translation: Хе-хе, пожалуй, ты права. Наше прошлое создаёт настоящее, а оно ведёт в будущее.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:12.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:12.original: The days I spent on the examinations with everyone... To me, they're a true treasure of my youth!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:12.translation: Дни, которые я провела на экзаменах со всеми... Для меня это настоящее сокровище юности!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:13.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:13.original: Hehe... Treasure of your youth?! Ilmeria, you sound like an old woman...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:13.translation: Хе-хе... Сокровище юности?! Ильмерия, ты говоришь как старушка...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:14.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:14.original: Hey, don't laugh at me! I think it's a charming phrase - don't mock me when I'm being sentimental!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:14.translation: Эй, не смейся надо мной! По-моему, это очаровательная фраза — не насмехайся, когда я сентиментальна!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:15.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:15.original: Hehe, hahaha! You're right, I'm sorry. It was a lovely thing to say.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:15.translation: Хе-хе, ха-ха-ха! Ты права, прости. Это было мило сказано.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:16.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:16.original: In that case, I suppose meeting you, Ilmeria, was the greatest treasure of my youth.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:16.translation: Тогда, полагаю, встреча с тобой, Ильмерия, была величайшим сокровищем моей юности.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:18.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:18.original: ...Ah! Hey, look over there! There's something interesting on the ground! Let's go take a look!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:18.translation: ...Ах! Эй, посмотри туда! На земле что-то интересное! Пойдём посмотрим!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:20.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:20.original: Y-You can't say something like that, then just run off...! Hey...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_080.ebm:20.translation: Т-ты не можешь сказать такое и просто убежать...! Эй...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:0.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:0.original: Hehe, good puni. You eat up as much as you can.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:0.translation: Хе-хе, хороший пуни. Ешь сколько влезет.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:2.original: Ah, you really are so adorable... Hehe, hehehe...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:2.translation: Ах, ты и правда такая милая... Хе-хе, хе-хе-хе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:3.original: Yes, it is adorable. Can I have a touch?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:4.original: Oh, me too, me too! Can I poke it?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:4.translation: Ой, мне тоже, мне тоже! Можно ткнуть?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:6.original: Hehe, sorry. The door was unlocked, so we came right in.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:6.translation: Хе-хе, извини. Дверь была незаперта, так что мы сразу вошли.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:7.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:7.original: Y-You two seem to be treating this place like it's your own house these days...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:7.translation: В-вы двое в последнее время относитесь к этому месту как к своему дому...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:8.original: No, no, not at all. But more importantly, teacher...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:8.translation: Нет-нет, совсем нет. Но важнее, учитель...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:9.original: What's it like, keeping a palm-sized puni?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:9.translation: Каково это — держать пуни размером с ладонь?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:10.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:10.translation: А...? Что ты имеешь в виду?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:11.original: Well, I've always wanted to have a palm-sized puni, ever since I was a little girl...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:11.translation: Ну, я с детства мечтала о пуни размером с ладонь...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:12.original: But I always told her she couldn't, because I knew she'd make me look after it.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:12.translation: Но я всегда говорила ей «нельзя», потому что знала: ухаживать за ним заставлю меня.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:13.original: But if they're easy to look after, then even I could do it! Then I could get one!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:13.translation: Но если за ними легко ухаживать, то даже я справлюсь! Тогда я смогу завести одного!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:14.original: So tell me, Ilmeria! Do I have what it takes to look after a palm-sized puni?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:14.translation: Так скажи, Ильмерия! Хватит ли у меня способностей присмотреть за пуни размером с ладонь?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:17.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:17.original: Haha, that's harsh, even by my standards. Are they really that hard to look after?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:17.translation: Ха-ха, это жестоко даже по моим меркам. Неужели за ними так сложно ухаживать?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:18.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:18.original: Not really, no. All you have to do is give them food and water every day.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:18.translation: Не особо. Нужно лишь каждый день давать еду и воду.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:19.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:19.original: But they're so little, and so soft, that they often get stuck in little gaps. In other words...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:19.translation: Но они такие маленькие и мягкие, что часто застревают в щелях. Другими словами...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:20.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:20.original: Oh, I see... Sue's always so bad at keeping organized that she's guaranteed to lose it.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:20.translation: А, понятно... Сью всегда так плохо держит порядок, что наверняка его потеряет.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:21.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:21.original: I-I'm not bad at it... I just don't do it, is all...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:21.translation: Я-я неплохо с этим справляюсь... Просто не делаю этого, вот и всё...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:22.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:22.original: ...But if you want to keep a palm-sized puni, you need to start by keeping your room tidy, Sue.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:22.translation: ...Но если хочешь завести пуни размером с ладонь, начни с того, чтобы держать комнату в порядке, Сью.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:24.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:24.original: Hahaha. But if you do learn to tidy up after yourself better, I won't object to you keeping a puni.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:24.translation: Ха-ха-ха. Но если научишься лучше убирать за собой, я не буду возражать против пуни.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:25.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:25.original: Hmm, I don't know... I think I'll make do with coming to see Ilmeria's puni...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:25.translation: Хм, не знаю... Думаю, обойдусь тем, что буду приходить смотреть на пуни Ильмерии...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:26.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:26.original: But... But I'm saying all you have to do is tidy up after yourself and you can have one...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:26.translation: Но... Но я же говорю: достаточно убирать за собой — и можно завести одного...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:27.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:27.original: Augh... It's times like these that I just don't understand you, Sue...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_090.ebm:27.translation: Уф... В такие моменты я просто тебя не понимаю, Сью...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:1.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:1.original: What's the matter, Punyu? Are you hungry? I suppose you must be.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:1.translation: Что случилось, Пуню? Голодна? Наверное, да.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:2.original: Hehe... I'm in a good mood today, so I'll make you something extra-delicious. It'll be worth the wait.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:2.translation: Хе-хе... У меня сегодня хорошее настроение, так что приготовлю тебе что-нибудь особенно вкусное. Подожди — оно того стоит.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:4.original: My word, did you see that, my dear? Our beloved teacher Ilmeria has a mile wide smile.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:4.translation: Честное слово, видела, моя дорогая? У нашей любимой учительницы Ильмерии улыбка от уха до уха.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:5.original: I did indeed see that. She really does love that puni.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:5.translation: Видела-видела. Она и правда обожает этого пуни.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:6.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:6.original: Hey, you two! What are you doing in my room yet again?! You don't live here!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:6.translation: Эй, вы двое! Что вы снова делаете в моей комнате?! Вы здесь не живёте!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:7.original: Hehe, sorry. We just wanted to have some tea with our teacher...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:7.translation: Хе-хе, извини. Мы просто хотели попить чаю с нашим учителем...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:8.original: And we simply happened to come across such a hila-... I mean, fascinating scene...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:8.translation: И просто случайно наткнулись на такую заба... то есть захватывающую сцену...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:9.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:9.original: Ooh... Ooh... Don't you mock me! Don't make fun of me like that!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:9.translation: Ох... Ох... Не издевайтесь надо мной! Не смейтесь надо мной так!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:10.original: We would never! We would never make fun of you! It's completely normal to care for your pets.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:10.translation: Мы бы никогда! Мы никогда не будем над вами смеяться! Совсем нормально заботиться о питомцах.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:11.original: Exactly. Besides... When you're so head-over-heels for your puni, you act in such a classical Ilmeria-like way!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:11.translation: Точно. К тому же... Когда ты так без ума от своего пуни, ты ведёшь себя по-настоящему по-ильмерийски!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:12.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:12.original: What's that supposed to mean?! You are making fun of me after all!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:12.translation: Что это должно значить?! Вы всё-таки надо мной смеётесь!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:13.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:13.original: Haha... But Ilmeria... What was it that made you decide to keep a pet in the first place?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:13.translation: Ха-ха... Но, Ильмерия... Что вообще заставило вас завести питомца?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:14.original: Oh, yes. All of a sudden you just seemed to have one. What happened?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:14.translation: О да. Внезапно он у вас просто появился. Что случилось?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:17.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:17.original: I... I was lonely, all right?! I hated coming back to an empty atelier every night!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:17.translation: Мне... мне было одиноко, ясно?! Я ненавидела каждый вечер возвращаться в пустое ателье!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:18.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:18.original: That's why... That's why I wanted a puni to be here to wait for me at the very least.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:18.translation: Вот почему... Вот почему я хотела, чтобы здесь хотя бы пуни ждал меня.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:19.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:19.original: I-Is there something wrong with that?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:22.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:22.original: Ilmeria! Please feel free to come and visit us any time you like! We'll have a warm meal waiting for you!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:22.translation: Ильмерия! Пожалуйста, приходите к нам в любое время! Мы будем ждать вас с тёплым ужином!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:23.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:23.original: That's right! Come every day... In fact, why not come and live with us?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:23.translation: Верно! Приходите каждый день... Да что там — поселитесь у нас?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:24.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:24.original: Feel free to rely on us whenever you need us! After all, we're your loyal students!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:24.translation: Не стесняйтесь полагаться на нас, когда понадобимся! Ведь мы ваши преданные ученицы!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:25.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:25.original: Yes! Come here, beloved teacher, and give us a hug!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:25.translation: Да! Идите сюда, любимый учитель, и обнимите нас!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:26.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:26.original: Augh, I don't need your pity! Don't patronize me! I should never have said anything! Augh!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_100.ebm:26.translation: Уф, мне не нужна ваша жалость! Не покровительствуйте мне! Зря я вообще что-то сказала! Уф!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:1.original: Oh, come on in! It's unusual to see you here, Ilmeria.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:1.translation: О, заходи! Необычно видеть тебя здесь, Ильмерия.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:2.original: Oh, not really... You just spend way too much time at my atelier...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:2.translation: Ой, не то чтобы... Просто ты слишком часто торчишь у меня в ателье...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:3.original: ...But never mind that. Today, I am here to give you a present.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:3.translation: ...Но неважно. Сегодня я пришла сделать тебе подарок.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:4.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:4.original: What, a present? Really? Oh, how wonderful! What kind of present?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:4.translation: Что, подарок? Правда? О, как чудесно! Какой подарок?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:5.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:5.original: Hehe, look and be amazed. This is your present... right here!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:5.translation: Хе-хе, смотри и удивляйся. Вот твой подарок... прямо здесь!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:7.original: Wow, it's so adorable...! A palm-sized puni...! But why?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:7.translation: Вау, такой милый...! Пуни размером с ладонь...! Но почему?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:8.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:8.original: There was just one left unsold at the shop. It looked so sad that I just had to take it.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:8.translation: В магазине остался один непроданный. Выглядел таким грустным, что я просто не смогла его оставить.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:9.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:9.original: And you always go on about how cute my puni are when you visit my atelier...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:9.translation: А ты всегда говоришь, какие мои пуни милые, когда заходишь ко мне...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:10.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:10.original: So I figured you'd take good care of this one...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:10.translation: Вот я и подумала, что ты хорошо о нём позаботишься...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:11.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:11.original: Thank you...! Hehe, I'm so happy! My name is Firis. You and I will be the best of friends!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:11.translation: Спасибо...! Хе-хе, я так рада! Меня зовут Фирис. Мы с тобой будем лучшими друзьями!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:13.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:13.original: Hehe, it looks like it likes you. Come on, then, give it a name.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:13.translation: Хе-хе, похоже, ты ему нравишься. Ну же, дай ему имя.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:14.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:14.original: Oh, yes, of course! Hmm... Let's see, a name that's cute yet cool at the same time... I've got it!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:14.translation: О да, конечно! Хм... Имя милое и в то же время крутое... Есть!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:18.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:18.original: *Pet, pet*... You're so cute, Puniboy... I hope you grow up to be big and strong...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:18.translation: *Гладит-гладит*... Ты такой милый, Пунибой... Надеюсь, вырастешь большим и сильным...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:20.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:20.original: Puniboy...? Hmm... She really has a... how shall I put it...?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_110.ebm:20.translation: Пунибой...? Хм... У неё и правда... как бы это сказать...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:0.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:0.original: Firis, I'm coming in! How's Puniboy doing...?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:0.translation: Фирис, я вхожу! Как поживает Пунибой...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:2.original: H-He's huge! Is that really you, Puniboy?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:2.translation: О-он огромный! Это правда ты, Пунибой?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:3.original: Ah, Ilmeria! Hehe, hasn't Puniboy grown big?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:3.translation: Ах, Ильмерия! Хе-хе, разве Пунибой не вырос?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:4.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:4.original: I think it's grown a little too big! It's supposed to be a palm-sized puni!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:4.translation: Мне кажется, он вырос слишком сильно! Он же должен быть пуни размером с ладонь!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:5.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:5.original: It's pretty much the same size as a regular puni! What did you do?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:5.translation: Он почти как обычный пуни! Что ты сделала?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:6.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:6.original: Huh, I didn't do anything... I just fed him regular food...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:6.translation: А? Я ничего такого не делала... Просто кормила обычной едой...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:7.original: Come on, Puniboy, dinner time! Today we have a super-mega-massive helping of hamburger steaks!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:7.translation: Давай, Пунибой, ужин! Сегодня супер-мега-огромная порция котлет!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:9.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:9.original: Here you go, Puniboy! Enormous rib-eye steaks for dinner! Hehe, let's eat them together!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:9.translation: Вот, Пунибой! Огромные стейки рибай на ужин! Хе-хе, давай съедим их вместе!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:11.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:11.original: Puniboy! Roast rabbit for dinner tonight! Extra large helpings! But you can eat this much with no trouble, right?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:11.translation: Пунибой! Сегодня на ужин жареный кролик! Очень большие порции! Но ты ведь без труда столько съешь, правда?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:13.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:13.original: ...See? I haven't fed it anything unusual, right?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:13.translation: ...Видишь? Я не кормила его ничем необычным, верно?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:14.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:14.original: The portions! Portions are the problem! How could you give it so much?! Of course it's going to grow, eating all that!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:14.translation: Порции! Проблема в порциях! Как можно давать ему столько?! Конечно, он вырастет, если столько есть!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:15.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:15.original: ...Hm? Hang on... "Of course it'll grow big, eating all that"... Oh, I see...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:15.translation: ...Хм? Погоди... «Конечно вырастет, если столько есть»... О, понятно...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:17.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:17.original: So that's why you grew so big, Firis...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:17.translation: Так вот почему ты такая крупная, Фирис...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:18.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:18.original: H-Hey, Ilmeria... You seem to be drifting somewhere far away...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:18.translation: Э-эй, Ильмерия... Ты словно уплыла куда-то далеко...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:19.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:19.original: Eating a lot is one way to grow bigger... That's right... I mean, I knew that, but...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:19.translation: Много есть — один из способов вырасти... Верно... То есть я это знала, но...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:20.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:20.original: I blew it. I made a mistake. If only I'd eaten more, I could have grown too...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:20.translation: Я всё испортила. Я ошиблась. Если бы я ела больше, я бы тоже выросла...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:21.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:21.original: Hey, Ilmeria... Hmm...? I wonder what got into her, Puniboy...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:21.translation: Эй, Ильмерия... Хм...? Интересно, что на неё нашло, Пунибой...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:23.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:23.original: ...Well, never mind. All that talk's made me hungry. Time to eat!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:23.translation: ...Ну, неважно. От всех этих разговоров я проголодалась. Пора есть!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:24.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:24.original: I've asked Liane to make us her specialty meat dish tonight. Should be delicious!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:24.translation: Я попросила Лианэ приготовить нам сегодня вечером её фирменное мясное блюдо. Должно быть вкусно!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:25.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:25.original: Come on, Puniboy! Let's eat until our bellies almost explode!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_120.ebm:25.translation: Давай, Пунибой! Будем есть, пока животы почти не лопнут!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:1.original: Wahh, Ilmeria! Wh-What's the matter?! Why are you apologizing?! What happened?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:1.translation: Ваа, Ильмерия! Ч-что случилось?! Почему вы извиняетесь?! Что произошло?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:2.original: How could I have been so stupid...? I forgot to teach you the most important thing about being an alchemist!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:2.translation: Как я могла быть такой глупой...? Я забыла научить вас самому главному для алхимика!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:3.original: Huh, really?! Umm... What would that be...?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:3.translation: Правда?! Эм... И что же это...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:5.original: Huh...? Self-introductions...? You mean, like you're always doing... Ahem.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:5.translation: А...? Самопредставление...? Вы имеете в виду то, что всегда делаете... Кхм.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:6.original: I am Ilmeria von Leinweber. Nothing less than a greatest alchemy genius of our day! ...Like this, you mean?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:6.translation: Я Ильмерия фон Лейнвебер. Не что иное, как величайший гений алхимии наших дней! ...Вот так, да?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:7.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:7.original: Precisely. You can't make a living as an alchemist without one of those, right?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:7.translation: Именно. Без такого не проживёшь алхимиком, верно?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:9.original: I'm not sure it's all that necessary...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:9.translation: Не уверена, что это так уж необходимо...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:10.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:10.original: ...Practice begins immediately. First, we have to think up some words.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:10.translation: ...Практика начинается немедленно. Сначала нужно придумать слова.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:11.original: Is our teacher all right? You don't think she hit her head or something?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:11.translation: С нашей учительницей всё в порядке? Не думаешь, что она ударилась головой или что-то вроде?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:12.original: Either that, or the stress from overwork has finally got to her... Either way, she's acting weird.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:12.translation: Либо так, либо стресс от переутомления наконец её добрался... В любом случае она ведёт себя странно.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:13.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:13.original: What are you two gossiping about?! Get over here and show me your first proposals! Come on!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:13.translation: О чём вы двое сплетничаете?! Идите сюда и покажите мне первые варианты! Ну же!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:16.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:16.original: ...Time for you to show me what you can do. Are you ready?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:16.translation: ...Пора показать мне, на что вы способны. Готовы?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:18.original: I'm feeling pretty embarrassed, but apart from that...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:18.translation: Мне очень неловко, но кроме этого...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:19.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:19.original: Hehe, fine. Sue, you go first! Wow us!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:19.translation: Хе-хе, отлично. Сью, ты первая! Удиви нас!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:20.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:20.original: Haha! I am Suelle Malen, an alchemist as brilliant as a glorious sunflower!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:20.translation: Ха-ха! Я Сюэль Мален, алхимик, сияющая как великолепный подсолнух!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:21.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:21.original: Yes, yes, not bad at all. Splendid work, Sue.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:21.translation: Да-да, совсем неплохо. Великолепная работа, Сью.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:22.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:22.original: Haha, what a relief... I still don't know why we have to do this, though...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:22.translation: Ха-ха, какое облегчение... Хотя я до сих пор не знаю, зачем нам это...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:23.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:23.original: Now then, next up is Lydie. Don't let your sister show you up!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:23.translation: Итак, следующая — Лидия. Не дай сестре тебя затмить!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:24.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:24.original: A-Ahem. I-I am Lydie Malen, intellectual alchemist, g-graceful as a hydrangea...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:24.translation: К-кхм. Я-я Лиди Мален, интеллектуальный алхимик, г-грациозная как гортензия...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:25.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:25.original: Good... Very good! Excellent, Lydie! But you did seem a little embarrassed. You need to work on that.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:25.translation: Хорошо... Очень хорошо! Отлично, Лидия! Но ты выглядела немного смущённой. Над этим нужно поработать.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:26.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:26.original: A-Ah, yes, I'm sorry... I'll do my best...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:27.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:27.original: Good. Now both of you have self-introductions sorted out. In other words, you are true alchemists at last!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:27.translation: Хорошо. Теперь у вас обеих есть самопредставления. Иными словами, вы наконец настоящие алхимики!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:28.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:28.original: From now on, you must remember to use these self-introductions, and make a name for yourselves!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:28.translation: С этого момента не забывайте ими пользоваться и сделайте себе имя!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:29.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:29.original: ...Hey, Sue. I know she's our teacher, but...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:29.translation: ...Эй, Сью. Я знаю, что она наш учитель, но...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:31.speaker: Together
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:31.original: We're never going to use them.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:32.speaker: System
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_130.ebm:32.original: We're never going to use them.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:0.original: Hello, Firis. Sorry to bother you, but I have a question about distinguishing between ores...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:0.translation: Здравствуй, Фирис. Извини, что беспокоим, но у меня вопрос о том, как различать руды...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:1.original: Ha, very well. You've come to the right place. The "Ore Master," Firis, shall impart upon thee the secrets of ores!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:1.translation: Ха, отлично. Вы пришли куда надо. «Мастер руд» Фирис откроет вам тайны руд!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:3.original: She looks the same as usual to me...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:4.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:4.original: Come, little lambs... Speak unto me. Tell me which ore do you seek to find the truth of?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:4.translation: Придите, юные агнцы... Глаголите ко мне. Скажите, о какой руде желаете постичь истину?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:5.original: Umm... Er, well, great master, we desire to learn of the ores that doth burn red like the flames of hell...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:5.translation: Эм... Э-э, ну, великий мастер, мы желаем узнать о рудах, что пылают красным, словно пламя ада...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:6.original: Sue, you don't have to play along...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:7.original: ...And that is how you can tell a quality ruby from a one of a lesser value. Do you understand?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:7.translation: ...И вот так можно отличить качественный рубин от менее ценного. Понимаете?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:8.original: Yes, thank you. I'm just glad you went back to speaking like your normal self midway through.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:8.translation: Да, спасибо. Я просто рада, что в середине разговора ты вернулась к обычной речи.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:9.original: Haha, I suppose you realized you couldn't keep that up and teach us at the same time.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:9.translation: Ха-ха, полагаю, ты поняла, что так одновременно учить нас не получится.
