ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:10.original: Yes... It appears I am still but a mere stripling on the path to true enlightenment!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:10.translation: Да... Похоже, я всё ещё лишь юная ученица на пути к истинному просветлению!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:11.original: Um, Firis... Why do you sometimes speak in that strange manner?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:11.translation: Эм, Фирис... Почему ты иногда говоришь в такой странной манере?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:12.original: It just struck me as a little... well, actually, it struck me as quite odd.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:12.translation: Просто мне это показалось немного... ну, на самом деле довольно странным.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:13.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:13.original: Hahaha! I must respond to your noble thirst for knowledge! 'Tis an oath I swore to a faithful companion!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:13.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Должна ответить на вашу благородную жажду знаний! Сие — клятва, данная верному товарищу!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:14.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:14.original: Oh, I just don't understand what you're trying to say...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:14.translation: Ой, я просто не понимаю, что ты хочешь сказать...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:15.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:15.original: Don't worry, I'll translate for you... Ahem.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:15.translation: Не волнуйся, я тебе переведу... Кхм.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:16.original: Hahaha. I'll tell you if you want to know. I speak like this because of a friend I once traveled with.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:16.translation: Ха-ха-ха. Расскажу, если хотите знать. Я говорю так из-за друга, с которым когда-то путешествовала.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:17.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:17.original: He relieved me of my ignorance and granted me enlightenment. This onyx-clad fencer was dubbed Revy.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:17.translation: Он избавил меня от невежества и даровал просветление. Этого фехтовальщика в ониксе звали Реви.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:18.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:18.original: I knew nothing of the world, but he taught me so much.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:18.translation: Я ничего не знала о мире, но он многому меня научил.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:19.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:19.original: A mighty swordsman who dressed in black, his name was Revy.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:19.translation: Могучего фехтовальщика в чёрном звали Реви.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:20.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:20.original: His alimental creations were sumptuous...! Ah, to tug on the thread of those memories is to stimulate a fountain...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:20.translation: Его кулинарные творения были роскошны...! Ах, потянуть за нить этих воспоминаний — значит вызвать фонтан...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:21.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:21.original: Revy made delicious food...! Remembering it now is enough to make my mouth water!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:21.translation: Реви готовил вкусно...! От одного воспоминания текут слюнки!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:22.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:22.original: My speech is an attestation of the esteem in which I hold him! Hehe, do you wish to emulate my example?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:22.translation: Моя речь — свидетельство уважения к нему! Хе-хе, хочешь последовать моему примеру?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:23.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:23.original: I speak like this as a way of showing my respect for Revy. Hehe... You can copy me if you like.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:23.translation: Я говорю так, чтобы выразить уважение к Реви. Хе-хе... Если хочешь, можешь скопировать меня.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:24.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:24.original: Oh, I see. Thanks for the translation, Sue. I don't think I'll copy you, Firis.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:24.translation: А, понятно. Спасибо за перевод, Сью. Не думаю, что буду копировать тебя, Фирис.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:25.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:25.original: Huh?! How come?! It sounds so cool!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:25.translation: А?! Почему?! Это же так круто звучит!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:26.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:26.original: Because it's hard to do, and hard to understand! Imagine if we all spoke like that all the time!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:26.translation: Потому что это сложно и трудно понять! Представьте, если бы мы все постоянно так говорили!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:27.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:27.original: We'd spend our days just trying to sift through each other's sentences! I have no wish to do that!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:27.translation: Мы бы дни напролёт разбирали друг друга! У меня нет никакого желания этим заниматься!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:28.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:28.original: Ugh... I'm sorry, Revy... I have failed to impress upon them the beauty of your way of speech...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:28.translation: Уф... Прости, Реви... Мне не удалось донести до них красоту твоей речи...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:29.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:29.original: However, I shall not cede defeat! The time will come when you all shall be enticed into my vortex...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:29.translation: Однако я не признаю поражения! Придёт время, когда вас всех затянет в мой водоворот...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:30.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:30.original: *Sigh*... No, we won't. I'm tired, Sue. Let's go home...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:30.translation: *Вздыхает*... Нет, не затянет. Я устала, Сью. Пойдём домой...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:31.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:31.original: Indeed, beloved sister! We shall adjourn to our place of repose, to devote our days to the pursuit of knowledge!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:31.translation: Воистину, возлюбленная сестра! Удалимся в обитель покоя, дабы дни посвятить стремлению к знаниям!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:32.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:32.original: ...Straight to bed with no dinner for you, Sue.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:32.translation: ...Сейчас же в постель без ужина, Сью.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:33.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:33.original: Ah, hey, no fair, Lydie! It was just a joke! Lydie! Hey, Lydie! I'm sorry!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_140.ebm:33.translation: Ах, эй, это нечестно, Лиди! Это была шутка! Лиди! Эй, Лиди! Прости!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:1.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:1.original: Oh, Firis. Sorry, but I'm a little busy right now...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:1.translation: О, Фирис. Извини, я сейчас немного занята...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:2.original: I'll be done in a moment. Why don't you come in and take a seat?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:2.translation: Сейчас закончу. Почему бы тебе не войти и не присесть?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:3.original: Sure, I'll just relax here for a bit.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:4.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:4.original: ...Hmm, let's see. Things have changed around here a little since I last saw it... Huh?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:4.translation: ...Хм, посмотрим. Здесь всё немного изменилось с тех пор, как я была в последний раз... А?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:5.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:5.original: Wh-What's this...?! Ilmeria, is this...? Hehehe...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:7.original: I remember this! I gave it to you, right?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:7.translation: Я помню это! Я же тебе его подарила, правда?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:8.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:8.original: Wow... It's so nice to see you've taken such good care of it.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:8.translation: Ух ты... Так приятно видеть, что ты так хорошо о нём заботилась.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:9.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:9.original: N-N-No, you've got it wrong! It's a different one! A different chick!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:9.translation: Н-н-нет, ты ошибаешься! Это другой! Другой цыплёнок!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:10.original: Huh, really? You mean this isn't Piko?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:10.translation: Правда? То есть это не Пико?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:11.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:11.original: That's right! This is Pisuke! He's an energetic young boy, related to Piko!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:11.translation: Верно! Это Писукэ! Он энергичный мальчик, родственник Пико!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:12.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:12.original: Piko isn't here anymore! That's right - and if I say she's gone, she's gone!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:12.translation: Пико здесь больше нет! Верно — и если я говорю, что она ушла, значит, ушла!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:13.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:13.original: Hmm, is that right...? That's a little sad...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:15.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:15.original: Ilmeria, you're telling me you got rid of Piko, aren't you? After I gave her to you...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:15.translation: Ильмерия, ты говоришь, что избавилась от Пико? После того как я тебе её подарила...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:16.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:16.original: I've still got the original "Gyoromaru" that you gave me...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:16.translation: У меня до сих пор есть оригинальный «Гёромару», который ты мне подарила...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:17.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:17.original: (Liane hates it, though, so I keep it shut away in a box, but still...)
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:17.translation: (Правда, Лианэ его ненавидит, поэтому я держу его в коробке, но всё же...)

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:19.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:19.original: *Sigh*... It's hard to hear that the present I gave you just wasn't special to you at all...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:19.translation: *Вздыхает*... Тяжело слышать, что подарок, который я тебе дала, совсем не был для тебя особенным...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:20.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:20.original: B-B-B-B-But...! But that's... That's not how...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:21.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:21.original: You know full well that isn't true! All right, I confess! This is Piko! This is the original Piko!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:21.translation: Ты прекрасно знаешь, что это неправда! Ладно, признаюсь! Это Пико! Это та самая Пико!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:22.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:22.original: Y-You know I would never throw away a present you gave me...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:22.translation: Т-ты знаешь, я бы никогда не выбросила подарок, который ты мне дала...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:23.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:23.original: Ilmeria...! Thank you! You've made me so happy!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:23.translation: Ильмерия...! Спасибо! Ты сделала меня такой счастливой!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:24.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:24.original: I hope you'll think of her as if she were me, and take good care of her.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:24.translation: Надеюсь, ты будешь думать о ней как обо мне и хорошо о ней заботиться.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:26.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:26.original: I'm feeling kind of hungry. I think I'll have some sweets. Last time, they were here... Ah, here they are!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:26.translation: Что-то проголодалась. Съём немного сладостей. В прошлый раз они были здесь... Ах, вот они!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:27.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:27.original: ...Think of her as if she were Firis...?! But I always sleep with Piko...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:27.translation: ...Думать о ней как о Фирис...?! Но я всегда сплю с Пико...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:28.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:28.original: Mmm, these are good... You always buy the best sweets, Ilmeria...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:28.translation: Ммм, вкусные... Ты всегда покупаешь самые лучшие сладости, Ильмерия...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:29.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:29.original: Sleep with Firis... No. This is just Piko, there's nothing more...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:29.translation: Спать с Фирис... Нет. Это всего лишь Пико, больше ничего...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:30.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:30.original: Ah, aaaughhhh! Wh-What am I supposed to do?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:31.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:31.original: Hey, Ilmeria, you've stopped moving. Hurry up and finish your work so we can play.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:31.translation: Эй, Ильмерия, ты застыла. Поторопись и закончи работу, чтобы мы могли поиграть.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:32.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:32.original: Hey, are you listening? Ilmeria? Can you hear me?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_150.ebm:32.translation: Эй, ты слушаешь? Ильмерия? Ты меня слышишь?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:0.original: Hey, Ilmeria. I don't know why I never mentioned it before, but your ribbons are really cute.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:0.translation: Эй, Ильмерия. Не знаю, почему раньше не говорила, но твои ленты очень милые.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:1.original: Hehe, you always seem to wear one... It's kind of like your trademark now.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:1.translation: Хе-хе, кажется, ты всегда носишь одну... Теперь это вроде твоей визитной карточки.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:2.original: Oh my, what a lovely thing to say. I do think very carefully about my ribbons.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:2.translation: О боже, как приятно слышать. Я очень тщательно подхожу к выбору лент.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:3.original: Hah, I figured as much! What things in particular do you look for?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:3.translation: Ха, я так и думала! На что ты особенно смотришь?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:4.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:4.original: Let's see. The most important factor... is size!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:6.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:6.original: Hmph, yes, size is absolutely vital! Don't you think bigger ribbons look cuter?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:6.translation: Хмф, да, размер абсолютно важен! Разве большие ленты не выглядят милее?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:7.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:7.original: Plus, when I wear a large ribbon, you can always tell it's me, even from a distance!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:7.translation: К тому же, когда я ношу большую ленту, меня всегда узнают, даже издалека!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:8.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:8.original: In order to really stand out as an alchemist, a ribbon is absolutely essential!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:8.translation: Чтобы по-настоящему выделиться как алхимик, лента просто необходима!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:9.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:9.original: Oh, uh, yeah, sure... Haha... Bigger is better...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:9.translation: О, э-э, да, конечно... Ха-ха... Чем больше, тем лучше...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:10.original: Although to be honest... I think the real reason she wears one is to make her look taller...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:10.translation: Хотя если честно... Думаю, настоящая причина, почему она её носит, — чтобы выглядеть выше...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:11.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:11.original: But I can't say that to her. She'll be furious. And besides, she's very sensitive about her height...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:11.translation: Но я не могу ей этого сказать. Она будет в ярости. И к тому же она очень чувствительна к своему росту...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:12.original: No, I'm far too mature to poke fun at her about that...! No, far too mature...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:12.translation: Нет, я слишком взрослая, чтобы подшучивать над ней из-за этого...! Нет, слишком взрослая...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:13.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:13.original: ...Uh, Firis? I can hear everything you're saying.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:13.translation: ...Эм, Фирис? Я слышу всё, что ты говоришь.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:14.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:14.original: What?! You mean I said all that aloud?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:14.translation: Что?! То есть я всё это сказала вслух?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:15.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:15.original: ...Very clearly. And now I know exa-actly what it is you really think of me.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:15.translation: ...Очень отчётливо. И теперь я то-очно знаю, что ты на самом деле обо мне думаешь.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:16.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:16.original: I know you think I'm a tiny little pixie who needs a big ribbon to make herself look taller than a young child!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:16.translation: Знаю, ты думаешь, что я крошечная пикси, которой нужна большая лента, чтобы выглядеть выше маленького ребёнка!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:17.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:17.original: Huh?! Hang on, Ilmeria! I never said anything like that!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:17.translation: А?! Погоди, Ильмерия! Я ничего такого не говорила!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:18.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:18.original: Urgh... Maybe I should send her a nice ribbon later as an apology... Oh-ho... Sorry, Ilmeria...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_160.ebm:18.translation: Ух... Может, позже пришлю ей красивую ленточку в качестве извинения... О-го... Прости, Ильмерия...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:0.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:0.original: ...Hey, Firis, did I tell you I ran into Drossel again recently?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:0.translation: ...Эй, Фирис, я тебе говорила, что недавно снова столкнулась с Дроссель?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:1.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:1.original: She patted me on the head so much, just like in the old days... It really took me back...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:1.translation: Она так гладила меня по голове, как в былые времена... Меня это так вернуло в прошлое...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:2.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:2.original: Hahaha, that's just like Drossel. She always doted on you like you were one of her dolls.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:2.translation: Ха-ха-ха, это так похоже на Дроссель. Она всегда обожала тебя, будто ты одна из её кукол.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:3.original: Yes, it was all a bit hard to take, frankly! But it made me wonder...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:3.translation: Да, честно говоря, было тяжеловато! Но это заставило меня задуматься...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:4.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:4.original: What exactly is everyone up to these days?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:5.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:5.original: ...Yes. Well, we know about Sophie and Plachta, and of course Liane.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:5.translation: ...Да. Ну, мы знаем о Софи и Плахте и, конечно, о Лианэ.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:6.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:6.original: Hehe, those three haven't changed a bit since the old days. That's all part of their charm.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:6.translation: Хе-хе, эти трое ни капельки не изменились со старых времён. В этом и их очарование.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:7.original: Yes. Apart from them... I hear Angriff's still working hard as the headmaster.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:7.translation: Да. А кроме них... Я слышала, что Ангрифф всё ещё усердно работает директором.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:8.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:8.original: (...I can't tell Firis that he predicted I would never grow tall.)
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:8.translation: (...Не могу сказать Фирис, что он предсказал: я никогда не вырасту высокой.)

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:9.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:9.original: Oh, I saw a cookbook written by Revy in a bookshop the other day.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:9.translation: О, на днях я увидела в книжном кулинарную книгу Реви.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:10.original: Really?! Hmm, my noble compatriot. I have no idea what he's up to now, though.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:10.translation: Правда?! Хм, мой благородный соратник. Хотя я понятия не имею, чем он сейчас занимается.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:11.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:11.original: Hahaha... That's true. I wonder if he's making a real effort to find that treasure...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:11.translation: Ха-ха-ха... Это правда. Интересно, прилагает ли он реальные усилия, чтобы найти то сокровище...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:12.original: I'm sure he's doing fine... I wonder if Kald and Oskar are still on their journey.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:12.translation: Уверена, с ним всё в порядке... Интересно, Калд и Оскар всё ещё в пути?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:13.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:13.original: I guess they are. Those two always had a concrete goal. I guess Heintz is the same in that respect.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:13.translation: Думаю, да. У этих двоих всегда была конкретная цель. Хайнц в этом отношении такой же.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:14.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:14.original: Yes, Heintz too... Haha. I bet he's still clumsily hunting monsters...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:14.translation: Да, Хайнц тоже... Ха-ха. Могу поспорить, он всё ещё неуклюже охотится на монстров...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:15.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:15.original: ...That's right - I almost forgot! Shanon! I got a letter from her saying she is now the vice-captain of the knights!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:15.translation: ...Точно — чуть не забыла! Шанон! Я получила от неё письмо: теперь она вице-капитан рыцарей!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:16.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:16.original: Really?! That's a huge jump up for her! ...She was a knight of Adalet, right?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:16.translation: Правда?! Для неё это огромный скачок! ...Она была рыцарем Адалета, верно?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:17.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:17.original: Which means... We might even run into her if we search this town...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:17.translation: А значит... Мы можем даже столкнуться с ней, если поищем в этом городе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:18.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:18.original: True...! I'm going to try and find her one of these days!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:19.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:19.original: Haha, let me know and I'll come with you. Still...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:19.translation: Ха-ха, дай знать — и я пойду с тобой. Всё же...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:20.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:20.original: When you think back on the past like this, we really have traveled with so many people...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:20.translation: Когда вот так вспоминаешь прошлое, понимаешь: мы и правда путешествовали со столькими людьми...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:21.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:21.original: Yes, haven't we? And they all taught me so much...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:21.translation: Да, правда? И все они многому меня научили...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:22.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:22.original: Hehe, me too. I really am glad I met them all.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:22.translation: Хе-хе, меня тоже. Я и правда рада, что встретила их всех.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:23.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:23.original: We've all gone our separate ways now... But I'm sure they're all doing fine!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:23.translation: Сейчас наши пути разошлись... Но уверена: у них у всех всё хорошо!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:24.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:24.original: Exactly! They're all walking their own paths, and I'm sure they're all happy!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:24.translation: Точно! Все идут своей дорогой, и уверена — они счастливы!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:25.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:25.original: We have to make sure we keep on doing our best, so that when we run into them again...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:25.translation: Мы должны и дальше выкладываться, чтобы, когда снова встретимся...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:26.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:26.original: We can declare with a smile that our lives have been great too.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:26.translation: Могли с улыбкой сказать, что и наша жизнь была прекрасной.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:27.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:27.original: Hehe, of course. Just who do you think I am?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:27.translation: Хе-хе, конечно. Как ты думаешь, кто я такая?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:28.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:28.original: I'm going to make my name known far and wide, so that they hear all about me, like it or not!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:28.translation: Я сделаю своё имя известным повсюду, чтобы обо мне услышали все — нравится им это или нет!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:29.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:29.original: Well, I won't be left behind either! Hehe...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:29.translation: Что ж, я тоже не останусь позади! Хе-хе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:30.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:30.original: May fortune smile upon the futures of us all.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_170.ebm:30.translation: Пусть удача улыбнётся будущему каждого из нас.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:3.original: Uh, Sue? I just saw what I thought I saw, right?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:3.translation: Э, Сью? Я только что увидела то, что мне показалось, да?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:4.original: ...Yup. Firis has been running round and round in circles in the same place.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:4.translation: ...Ага. Фирис бегает кругами на одном месте.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:5.original: What's up with her...? I wonder if she ate something she shouldn't have...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:5.translation: Что с ней...? Интересно, не съела ли она чего-то не того...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:6.original: Ah, I've got it! I bet she's on a diet! She probably ate too much, and now she's feeling bloated...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:6.translation: Ах, поняла! Наверное, она на диете! Слишком много съела и теперь чувствует тяжесть...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:7.original: Yeah, that could be it. Come to think of it, Firis has been looking a lot rounder recently...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:7.translation: Да, может быть. Если подумать, Фирис в последнее время выглядит круглее...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:8.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:8.original: I have not! I am no rounder than I ever was!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:8.translation: Вовсе нет! Я ничуть не круглее, чем была!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:10.original: I thought I saw you looking at me while I was jogging, but I had no idea you were being so rude...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:10.translation: Мне казалось, вы смотрите на меня, пока я бегаю, но я и не думала, что будете такими грубыми...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:11.original: Jogging...? You mean, what you've been doing, it's...?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:11.translation: Бег...? То есть то, что ты делала, это...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:12.original: That's right, I'm running to keep myself strong. I used to be such a weakling I was called "bean sprout."
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:12.translation: Верно, я бегаю, чтобы оставаться сильной. Раньше я была такой слабачкой, что меня звали «росток фасоли».

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:14.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:14.original: Bean sprout! But in order to learn how to hunt from Liane, I needed to have a certain amount of physical strength.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:14.translation: Росток фасоли! Но чтобы учиться охоте у Лианэ, нужна была определённая физическая сила.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:15.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:15.original: So whenever I find the time, I do a little bit of training.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:15.translation: Поэтому, когда нахожу время, немного тренируюсь.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:16.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:16.original: The jogging you saw me do before was just one part of that... It is NOT because I am getting rounder!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:16.translation: Бег, который вы видели, — лишь часть этого... И это НЕ потому, что я становлюсь круглее!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:17.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:17.original: Oh, I see... I'm so sorry, we just...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:20.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:20.original: To have the self-awareness to understand your own weakness, and to do something about it...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:20.translation: Иметь самосознание, чтобы понять свою слабость и что-то с ней сделать...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:21.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:21.original: We must learn from your example...! Don't you agree, Lydie?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:21.translation: Мы должны учиться на твоём примере...! Согласна, Лиди?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:22.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:22.original: Huh? Oh, er, yes, certainly... I suppose I don't disagree...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:22.translation: А? О, э-э, да, конечно... Полагаю, не спорю...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:23.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:23.original: Firis! Do you mind if we train with you?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:23.translation: Фирис! Ты не против, если мы потренируемся с тобой?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:24.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:24.original: We want to get stronger too...! Stronger than we are now...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:24.translation: Мы тоже хотим стать сильнее...! Сильнее, чем сейчас...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:25.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:25.original: ...Very well. I respect your conviction. But I train very hard. Do you have what it takes to keep up?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:25.translation: ...Хорошо. Уважаю вашу решимость. Но я тренируюсь очень усердно. Сможете ли вы не отставать?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:26.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:26.original: Absolutely! We know what we're in for! Don't we, Lydie?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:26.translation: Абсолютно! Мы знаем, на что идём! Правда, Лиди?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:27.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:27.original: Huh?! Wh-What?! You mean I have to do this as well?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:27.translation: А?! Ч-что?! То есть я тоже должна?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:28.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:28.original: Okay, then let's get started! Time to begin the Merveille Endurance Race - 100 kilometers!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:28.translation: Тогда начинаем! Пора стартовать забег на выносливость Мервейль — сто километров!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:29.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:29.original: Yeah! Hurry up, Lydie, don't fall behind!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:30.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:30.original: O-One hundred kilometers?! I'll never be able to run that far... Ugh... All right then!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:30.translation: С-сто километров?! Я никогда столько не пробегу... Уф... Ладно!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:31.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:31.original: ...I shall head back home while no one's looking, and read a book.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_180.ebm:31.translation: ...Пока никто не смотрит, я вернусь домой и почитаю книгу.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:0.original: Please excuse the intrusion, my ladies. I have come here with a humble entreaty...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:0.translation: Прошу простить вторжение, миледи. Я явилась со скромной просьбой...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:1.original: H-Huh...? Uh... I-I humbly acquiesce... Both Lydie and I are honored to be at your service, m'lady...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:1.translation: Х-а...? Э-э... Я-я смиренно соглашаюсь... Для нас с Лиди честь быть к вашим услугам, миледи...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:2.original: Sue, stop speaking like that! You won't be able to stop!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:2.translation: Сью, перестань так говорить! Ты не сможешь остановиться!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:3.original: Anyway... How come you're being so polite, Firis? It really doesn't suit you.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:3.translation: Так или иначе... Почему ты такая вежливая, Фирис? Тебе это совсем не идёт.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:4.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:4.original: What?! Ah, um, well... I... I want to learn to paint!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:4.translation: Что?! Ах, эм, ну... Я... Я хочу научиться рисовать!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:6.original: Sue... That's a little too much, I think. At least try sounding more supportive...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:6.translation: Сью... Это, по-моему, слишком. Хотя бы постарайся звучать поддерживающе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:7.original: But I didn't mean anything by it... Besides, I think you're the one who's being critical - of me!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:7.translation: Но я ничего такого не имела в виду... К тому же это ты критикуешь меня!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:8.original: Yeah, I'm sorry. Dad's been wasting our money again, and it's made me a little grumpy...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:8.translation: Да, прости. Папа снова транжирит наши деньги, и я немного раздражена...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:9.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:9.original: Haha... You have your own worries, I see... Perhaps I should come back another day?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:9.translation: Ха-ха... У вас, вижу, свои заботы... Может, мне лучше прийти в другой день?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:10.original: No, no, there's no need for that. But how come you suddenly decided you wanted to paint?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:10.translation: Нет-нет, незачем. Но почему ты вдруг решила рисовать?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:12.original: What a very Firis-like answer! In that case... we'd be glad to teach you what we know, as little as that is!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:12.translation: Какой типично-фирисовский ответ! Тогда... мы с радостью научим тебя тому, что знаем — пусть и немногому!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:13.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:13.original: Yes, we should be able to show you the basics at least... Well, I hope we can...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:13.translation: Да, хотя бы основы показать сможем... Ну, надеюсь...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:14.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:14.original: There we are! All done! Hehehe, what do you think of my masterpiece?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:14.translation: Вот! Готово! Хе-хе-хе, что скажете о моём шедевре?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:15.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:15.original: I-It's really good...! It's almost too good! I can't believe this is your first time...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:15.translation: Э-это правда хорошо...! Почти слишком хорошо! Не могу поверить, что это в первый раз...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:16.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:16.original: Yeah...! You're way better than us...! I mean, it really feels like I'm inside your painting!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:16.translation: Ага...! Ты гораздо лучше нас...! Такое чувство, будто я внутри твоей картины!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:17.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:17.original: I can smell the scent of the leaves in the forest... I can hear the wind rushing through the grass...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:17.translation: Чувствую запах листьев в лесу... Слышу, как ветер шумит в траве...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:18.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:18.original: I know what you mean! It even has little animals running about... It's a magnificent landscape of a forest!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:18.translation: Знаю, о чём ты! Там даже бегают зверюшки... Великолепный лесной пейзаж!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:19.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:19.original: L-Landscape...? Forest? What on earth are you talking about?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:19.translation: П-пейзаж...? Лес? О чём вы, чёрт возьми, говорите?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:20.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:20.original: We're talking about your painting, of course. With all those trees - it's a forest, right?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:20.translation: О твоей картине, конечно. Со всеми этими деревьями — это же лес, правда?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:21.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:21.original: What? No! This is a portrait of Liane.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:22.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:22.original: What...?! Liane?! H-How is this a picture of Liane?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:22.translation: Что...?! Лианэ?! К-как это портрет Лианэ?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:23.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:23.original: This is her hair, and this is her face. And these animals are the prey she is hunting!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:23.translation: Это её волосы, а это лицо. А эти животные — добыча, на которую она охотится!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:24.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:24.original: Hmm...? I don't get it... It looks like a forest to me...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:24.translation: Хм...? Не понимаю... Мне кажется, это лес...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:25.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:25.original: Hmm... Firis may even be even more talented than Lydie in a certain way...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:25.translation: Хм... Фирис в каком-то смысле может быть даже талантливее Лиди...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:26.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:26.original: What?! Hey, what's that supposed to mean?! You listen here, Sue...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:26.translation: Что?! Эй, что это значит?! Послушай-ка, Сью...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:27.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:27.original: Hehehe... Very good. Now I can begin on my journey as an alchemist and artist! Hehe...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:27.translation: Хе-хе-хе... Отлично. Теперь я могу начать путь алхимика и художницы! Хе-хе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:28.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:28.original: It really is worth giving new things a try.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:28.translation: И правда стоит пробовать что-то новое.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:29.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:29.original: Sue! If you don't take that back, you'll pay for what you said!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_190.ebm:29.translation: Сью! Если не заберёшь слова назад, ты за них поплатишься!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:0.original: Lydie, Sue, are you home?! I...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:4.original: Ah, wait, don't go! It's not what you think!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:4.translation: Ах, подожди, не уходи! Это не то, что ты думаешь!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:5.original: Sorry! I'm sure that looked really odd, but I assure you there's an explanation! Really!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:5.translation: Прости! Уверена, это выглядело очень странно, но уверяю — есть объяснение! Правда!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:6.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:6.original: ...Are you sure I can come in? You looked like you were in the middle of some sort of ceremony...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:6.translation: ...Точно можно войти? У вас был такой вид, будто вы посреди какой-то церемонии...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:7.original: No, er, well... That is... Sue and I were listening to the voice of an ore...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:7.translation: Нет, э-э, ну... То есть... Мы со Сью слушали голос руды...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:9.original: Yes... We can hear the voices of our materials, but we were just wondering if we each heard the same thing...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:9.translation: Да... Мы слышим голоса материалов, и нам просто стало интересно: слышим ли мы одно и то же...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:10.original: We'd never actually compared notes when it comes to how the materials speak to us.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:10.translation: Мы никогда по-настоящему не сравнивали, как материалы говорят с нами.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:11.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:11.original: Come to think of it... Hehe, that sounds interesting! Count me in too!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:11.translation: Если подумать... Хе-хе, звучит интересно! Меня тоже посчитайте!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:12.original: You know I can hear the voices of ores as well! Let me join in on your ceremony!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:12.translation: Знаешь, я тоже слышу голоса руд! Позвольте присоединиться к вашей церемонии!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:13.original: Of course...! But it still isn't a ceremony... Okay, then, shall we begin?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:13.translation: Конечно...! Но это всё-таки не церемония... Хорошо, тогда начнём?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:14.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:14.original: This time, let's try not to look too weird...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:14.translation: На этот раз постараемся не выглядеть слишком странно...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:16.original: Come on, come on, come on, come on, come on...! Speak to me, speak to me, speak to me, speak to me!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:16.translation: Давай, давай, давай, давай, давай...! Говори со мной, говори со мной, говори со мной, говори со мной!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:17.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:17.original: Yes, yes... Oh, I see, yes... I understand. Can you tell me more...?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:17.translation: Да, да... О, понятно, да... Понимаю. Можешь рассказать подробнее...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:18.original: ...Okay, I've heard what it had to say. Are you ready?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:18.translation: ...Хорошо, я услышала, что она сказала. Готовы?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:19.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:19.original: Hmph, of course! How about you, Sue?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:20.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:20.original: Yes! Let's all take turns explaining the personality of the ore, and what it had to say! I'll go first!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:20.translation: Да! Давайте по очереди расскажем о характере руды и о том, что она сказала! Я первая!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:21.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:21.original: This particular ore has an aggressive, masculine personality, and it wants to become an all-powerful weapon.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:21.translation: Эта руда — агрессивная, с мужским характером, и хочет стать всемогущим оружием.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:22.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:22.original: Huh...? To me it sounded like a gentle, kind boy. It did say it wanted to get stronger by becoming a weapon...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:22.translation: А...? Мне она показалась нежным, добрым мальчиком. Она сказала, что хочет стать сильнее, став оружием...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:23.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:23.original: I heard a young man of 22 years of age. His homeland had been overrun by monsters.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:23.translation: Я услышала молодого человека двадцати двух лет. Его родину захватили монстры.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:24.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:24.original: Because of that, he was separated from his beloved. He wants to become a weapon and travel in search of her.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:24.translation: Из-за этого он разлучился с возлюбленной. Он хочет стать оружием и отправиться на её поиски.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:25.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:25.original: Hmm... Each of us heard the same ambition, but from very different characters...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:25.translation: Хм... Каждый из нас услышал одно и то же стремление, но у очень разных персонажей...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:26.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:26.original: Yes. And Firis heard way more detail than us. I guess that's just a difference in talent...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:26.translation: Да. И Фирис услышала куда больше деталей. Наверное, просто разница в таланте...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:27.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:27.original: I'm not sure, but... what really matters is that we can hear the voices of materials...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:27.translation: Не уверена, но... главное — мы слышим голоса материалов...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:28.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:28.original: If what they want turns out to be the same for all of us, then the other details don't really matter.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:28.translation: Если то, чего они хотят, совпадает для всех нас, то остальные детали не так важны.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:29.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:29.original: Firis is right... It is the true goal of alchemy to lead each material to its fated destiny!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:29.translation: Фирис права... Истинная цель алхимии — привести каждый материал к его предназначенной судьбе!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:30.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:30.original: Yeah! But this was kind of fun... Want to try it with something else?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:30.translation: Ага! Но это было весело... Хотите попробовать с чем-нибудь ещё?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:31.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:31.original: Haha, of course! I wonder what voices we'll hear this time...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:31.translation: Ха-ха, конечно! Интересно, какие голоса мы услышим на этот раз...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:32.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:32.original: Lydie, Sue, are you home?! I'm here to...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:32.translation: Лиди, Сью, вы дома?! Я пришла...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:34.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:34.original: It's coming, it's coming, it's coming, it's coming... I can hear it, I can hear it, I can hear it...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:34.translation: Идёт, идёт, идёт, идёт... Слышу, слышу, слышу...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:35.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:35.original: Oh, is that right? That must have been tough for you... But does that mean that...?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:35.translation: О, правда? Должно быть, тебе было тяжело... Но значит ли это, что...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:36.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:36.original: ...I think I must be a little tired. You can't have seen what you thought you saw, Ilmeria. Isn't that right... Hehe...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_200.ebm:36.translation: ...Думаю, я немного устала. Ты не могла видеть то, что тебе показалось, Ильмерия. Правда ведь... Хе-хе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:0.original: Urgh... Augh... Aaarghh! Stay calm, stay calm...! Don't lose your temper...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:0.translation: Урх... Ах... Аааа! Спокойствие, спокойствие...! Не теряй самообладания...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:1.original: Woah, Lydie's really angry... Um, did something happen, Lydie?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:1.translation: Ого, Лиди очень зла... Эм, что-то случилось, Лиди?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:3.original: Don't lie! You're looking mad enough to terrify all monsters around here!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:3.translation: Не ври! Ты выглядишь достаточно злобно, чтобы напугать всех здешних монстров!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:4.original: You think so...? Well, I am quite upset...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:4.translation: Думаешь...? Ну, я и правда очень расстроена...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:5.original: We owe more taxes, Dad keeps buying things, vegetable prices keep going up, our alchemy doesn't improve...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:5.translation: Мы должны больше налогов, папа продолжает покупать вещи, цены на овощи растут, наша алхимия не улучшается...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:6.original: You don't tidy up after yourself, and you think I don't notice the stuffed animals you secretly bought...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:6.translation: Ты за собой не убираешь и думаешь, я не замечаю мягких игрушек, которые тайком купила...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:7.original: And there's still so much more... Ohh... Urgh...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:7.translation: И это ещё далеко не всё... Ох... Урх...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:8.original: ...Uh-oh, this is bad. If Lydie explodes, our home will be lost...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:8.translation: ...Ой-ой, плохо. Если Лиди взорвётся, наш дом пропал...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:9.original: I-I have to do something...! Umm... Umm... Yes, that's it!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:9.translation: Я-я должна что-то сделать...! Эм... Эм... Да, вот оно!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:10.original: Lydie! Let's go to the sea!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:11.original: Huh? Why? If you're just coming up with ideas on a whim, I'll... Hehe, hehehe...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:11.translation: А? Почему? Если ты просто выдумываешь на ходу, я... Хе-хе, хе-хе-хе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:12.original: Uh-oh...! It's okay! It'll be okay... I think! Just do what I say!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:12.translation: Ой-ой...! Всё нормально! Всё будет хорошо... Наверное! Просто делай, как я говорю!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:13.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:13.original: ...Okay. I understand. The sea, right? ...Just as soon as I finish my work...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:13.translation: ...Хорошо. Поняла. Море, да? ...Как только закончу работу...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:14.original: Sh-She scares me... I just hope my plan works...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_210.ebm:14.translation: О-она меня пугает... Лишь бы мой план сработал...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:0.original: Well... I've done as Sue asked, and came here, but...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:0.translation: Ну... я сделала, как просила Сью, и пришла сюда, но...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:2.original: Aarghh! Uh, umm, listen to me, my dear sister!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:2.translation: Ааа! Э-эм, послушай меня, дорогая сестра!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:3.original: From time immemorial, there has been a tried and true way to relieve stress: to shout!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:3.translation: С незапамятных времён есть проверенный способ снять стресс: покричать!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:5.original: Yes! What I have come up with, dear sister, is the following plan: to shout at the sea to relieve your stress!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:5.translation: Да! Дорогая сестра, я придумала такой план: покричать на море, чтобы снять стресс!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:6.original: I see, so that's your plan... Yes, that might work...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:6.translation: Понятно, вот твой план... Да, это может сработать...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:7.original: Don't you think? I do! Go on, then! Start shouting right now, and get back to your real self!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:7.translation: Правда? Я так думаю! Тогда давай! Кричи прямо сейчас и возвращайся к себе настоящей!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:9.original: DAD... YOU'RE AN IRRESPONSIBLE FATHER!!! MIREILLE!! PLEASE LOWER OUR TAXES!!!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:9.translation: ПАПА... ТЫ БЕЗОТВЕТСТВЕННЫЙ ОТЕЦ!!! МИРЕЙ!! ПОЖАЛУЙСТА, СНИЗЬТЕ НАШИ НАЛОГИ!!!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:10.original: Wow, that's a loud voice... Lydie must really have been under pressure...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:10.translation: Ух ты, какой громкий голос... Лиди, должно быть, и правда была под давлением...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:11.original: ...I HATE PUBERTY!!! *Pant, pant*... Hehe, hehehe... Sue...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:11.translation: ...Я НЕНАВИЖУ ПУБЕРТАТ!!! *Пыхтит, пыхтит*... Хе-хе, хе-хе-хе... Сью...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:15.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:15.original: This is such a good idea! I could really get used to this!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:15.translation: Это такая хорошая идея! Я бы и правда могла к этому привыкнуть!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:16.original: O-Oh...?! Your face, Lydie... It looks like you've just had a curse lifted!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:16.translation: О-о...?! Твоё лицо, Лиди... Будто с тебя только что сняли проклятие!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:17.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:17.original: Hehehe, thank you, Sue! This really cheered me up!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:17.translation: Хе-хе-хе, спасибо, Сью! Это меня очень подняло!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:18.original: By way of thanks, and as an apology for being so grumpy, I'll make your favorite for dinner tonight!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:18.translation: В знак благодарности и в извинение за то, что была такой сварливой, сегодня вечером приготовлю твоё любимое!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:19.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:19.original: Yay! In that case, I'll have some of those 10,000 Coll Merveille beef steaks...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:19.translation: Ура! Тогда я возьму тех стейков из мервейской говядины за 10 000 коллов...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:21.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:21.original: Uh, I mean... I'd love to have curry! I hardly need any meat at all, just curry! Haha, hahaha...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:21.translation: Э-э, то есть... Мне бы хотелось карри! Мяса почти не нужно, только карри! Ха-ха, ха-ха-ха...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:22.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:22.original: Really? Then that's what I'll make! In fact, how about I make some seafood curry, with plenty of fish?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:22.translation: Правда? Тогда приготовлю! А как насчёт карри из морепродуктов с кучей рыбы?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:23.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:23.original: Whew, that was scary there for a while, but it looks like we made it safely through the crisis...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:23.translation: Уф, какое-то время было страшно, но, похоже, мы благополучно прошли кризис...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:24.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:24.original: I don't want Lydie to get so stressed anymore, so I'd better make sure to take her to the beach more often...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_220.ebm:24.translation: Не хочу, чтобы Лиди снова так нервничала, так что лучше чаще водить её на пляж...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_230.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_230.ebm:0.original: ...Should I have a good, loud shout?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_230.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_230.ebm:1.original: In that case, let's do this... Ahem!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_230.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_230.ebm:8.original: I WANT TO READ THE NEXT ISSUE OF MY COMIC BOOK!!!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_230.ebm:8.translation: ХОЧУ ПРОЧИТАТЬ СЛЕДУЮЩИЙ ВЫПУСК СВОЕГО КОМИКСА!!!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_230.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_230.ebm:10.original: I WANT TO SPEND MORE TIME WITH LUCIA!!!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_230.ebm:10.translation: ХОЧУ ПРОВОДИТЬ БОЛЬШЕ ВРЕМЕНИ С ЛЮСИЕЙ!!!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_230.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_230.ebm:12.original: It's a little embarrassing... I think I'll pass.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_240.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_240.ebm:0.original: ...Should I just shout out what I'm feeling in my heart?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_240.ebm:0.translation: ...Может, просто выкрикнуть то, что чувствую в сердце?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_240.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_240.ebm:1.original: Okay! Let's give this all I've got! Ready...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_240.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_240.ebm:3.original: I WANT TO LIVE IN LUXURY!!!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_240.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_240.ebm:7.original: THERE'RE NO SUCH THINGS AS GHOSTS!!!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_240.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_240.ebm:8.original: PULL YOURSELF TOGETHER, YOU USELESS FATHER!!!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_240.ebm:8.translation: ВОЗЬМИ СЕБЯ В РУКИ, БЕСПОЛЕЗНЫЙ ОТЕЦ!!!
